name: LunarSims: browser simulations of lunar settlement
description: Original browser simulation games set on the lunar surface, including Lunar Metropolis, an executable model of lunar settlement growth. The model couples an elevation field to a solar-exposure raycast and derives from that single coupling the distribution of water ice, photovoltaic output, and the economic value of ground. Three habitat strategies are represented and costed against each other: surface construction, arcologies bored downward into permanently shadowed ice deposits, and arcologies extending along pre-existing lava tubes.
runtimePlatform: Web browser; Node.js for headless verification
